frames.lateral: Gazebo world Y, centreline Y=0, POSITIVE Y = LEFT

primary_z_and_vz_DEALIASED.raw_signal: world Z from dynamic_pose/info + vertical rate differenced on the DISTINCT pose grid (see D1)

aero_lift_equals_weight.raw_signal: L = CL*qbar*S from the aerodynamics plugin's own diagnostics crossing m*g = 58.86 N

inferred_support_force_reaches_zero.raw_signal: INFERRED support force (DATA_REQUIRED: no contact sensor)

liftoff_speeds.note: VFR_HUD airspeed vs groundspeed, both from ArduPlane, at the de-aliased primary liftoff sample.

lateral_drift.convention: lateral displacement is Gazebo world Y; the runway centreline is Y=0 and the nose points along world +X at spawn, so POSITIVE Y = LEFT.

yaw_angle_departure_GZ_0p1deg.raw_signal: Gazebo world yaw from dynamic_pose/info >= 0.1 deg

surface_command_onset_ANY_NONZERO.raw_signal: any of the five actuator cmd_rad != 0

propulsion_asymmetry.net_reaction_torque_about_body_X_formula: Qr - Ql  (rotation_sign left=+1, right=-1; reaction = rotation_sign * (-Q_prop))
propulsion_asymmetry.Q_prop_SUM_label_note: The Part 4 harness calls this SUM 'the NET propeller reaction torque about the body roll axis'. Under the counter-rotating sign convention it is not; the DIFFERENCE above is. Both are given so the mislabel cannot propagate silently.
propulsion_asymmetry.net_thrust_yaw_moment_formula: 0.3000 m * (T_right - T_left); FLU, POSITIVE = NOSE LEFT

support_force.data_required: DIRECT normal-force measurement. Neither the runway world nor model/model.sdf carries a contact sensor. The Part 4 result file labels this 'MEASURED' - that label is wrong (see D3); the numbers were always the inferred ones.
